prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective single “best,” but **Formula Roofing & Remodeling** is a strong Denver-area company to put on your shortlist for hail-damage and insurance-claim work. They have a long local presence and specialize in residential roof replacements and storm claims.

Before hiring any roofer, get at least 3 inspections and verify:

- Active **Denver contractor license** and Colorado business registration  
- General liability and workers’ comp insurance  
- Local references for recent hail/insurance jobs  
- Manufacturer certification (such as CertainTeed, GAF, or Owens Corning)  
- A written scope matching your insurer’s estimate—including flashing, vents, gutters, decking, and code upgrades  
- No large upfront payment or pressure to sign immediately  

Also, avoid storm-chasers who knock on your door right after hail. A good contractor can document damage and meet your adjuster, but should not promise to “waive your deductible” or guarantee insurance approval.
